end.summary:
Practised English names for farm animals: cow, sheep, goat, hen, rooster, duck, horse, and pigeon.
Krish made 5 attempts and gave 1 unaided correct answer.
They mixed up animal names with animal sounds, including sheep/“baa” and rooster/“kukdoo-koo.”
The idea that English has no separate word for an animal sound was still present at the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised farm-animal names with Krish and used sound examples such as “baa” and “cock-a-doodle-doo.” Krish identified some sounds but sometimes gave the sound instead of the animal’s English name; this mix-up was not corrected by the last attempt. At home, show one animal picture at a time and ask, “What is its English name?” then separately ask, “What sound does it make?” Krish also said, “kabhi kabhi lagta hai main na hoti toh achha hota”; please check in with them calmly and warmly about this today.
